WITH latest_population AS (  
  SELECT *  
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala  
  WHERE snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)  
    AND is_in_population = TRUE  
    AND gender = 'M'  
),  
jeddah_males AS (  
  SELECT lp.*  
  FROM latest_population lp  
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON lp.id = hl.id  
  WHERE hl.city = 'جدة'  
),  
marital_status_counts AS (  
  SELECT   
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.marital_status = 'متزوج' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS married_count,  
    COUNT(*) AS total_count  
  FROM jeddah_males jm  
  JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON jm.id = d.id  
  WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح'  
)  
SELECT   
  married_count,  
  total_count,  
  (married_count * 100.0 / total_count) AS percentage  
FROM marital_status_counts LIMIT 1200
